evidenceLimits: Complete relevant families, not the complete dictionary. Omission does not prove absence. Selected senses are non-exhaustive and not independent level assignments. Mapping/source notes are author assertions to assess, not reviewer findings.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538020/やくしょ/役所; public administrative office, not generic private office.
rows.sourceNote: Publicやくしょ heading distinguished from archaic material and separateやくどころ. Place and institution uses are not artificially split.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538350/やくす/訳す; transitive godan translation or language interpretation.
rows.sourceNote: On-derivedヤク withす; kango metadata does not make it a suru or ichidan verb. Translate is language-to-language, not every generic interpretation. Full直す1599390:2 also supports translation.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538050/やくにん/役人; government official.
rows.sourceNote: Do not expand to every executive or person in charge;公務員 is a direct comparison, not proof every use has the same legal extension.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538280/やくひん/薬品; medicines and nonmedicinal chemical agents.
rows.sourceNote: Two dictionary senses, not an inference that all chemicals are medicines. No regulatory, safety or consumption rule is inferred from the noun.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538080/やくめ/役目; duty/role/function, not commercial business generally.
rows.sourceNote: ヤク+nativeめ follows the repository's on-first mixed-reading kango convention. No invented literal eye semantics or unsupported productive suffix meaning. Role/役割 register tendencies are not strict spoken/written partitions.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1577310/やけど/火傷; whole-word special reading, burn/scald injury.
rows.sourceNote: Usually kana. Search-only熱傷 spelling does not transferねっしょう or separate火傷かしょう into this reading. Figurative fingers-burned sense is additional teaching, not an independently sourced level.

source.waller_definition: walking around at night,night train,night travel

rows.mappingNote: Exact1584820/やこう/夜行; night travel and night-train abbreviation.
rows.sourceNote: Night bus/travel need not last all night or keep the passenger awake. 列車 has a general train label; electric/steam versus night operation are crossing distinctions, not an automatic synonym clique.
rows.identityNote: Sense2 is restricted toやこう; sense3 monster procession is restricted toやぎょう and is contrast-only.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1537770/やじるし/矢印; arrow symbol, not a physical arrow.
rows.sourceNote: Nativeや+しるし with voicing toじるし. Colloquial romantic-interest/direction-of-attention sense is additional teaching. Public Daijisen second sense differs; ordinal sense numbers are not aligned across dictionaries.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1537780/やたら; normally kana, adverb and na-adjective.
rows.sourceNote: Public source verifiesに、と、な constructions. 矢鱈 is rare ateji, not literal arrow/codfish semantics. Missing standalone comparison entries forやたらに/やたらと do not invalidate the constructions. Excess or indiscrimination does not make every comparative or degree word equivalent.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1538200/やっきょく/薬局; reuse existing baseline article's pharmacy/shop teaching.
rows.sourceNote: Add explicit sourcedjlpt2 only. Preserve primary identity/reading/title/body and smallっ/ょ explanation. Hospital dispensary sense2 remains in complete source evidence, not claimed as new teaching.

source.waller_definition: to attack (an enemy),to beat,to do away with,to finish off

rows.mappingNote: Exact1612950/やっつける; normally kana, transitive ichidan.
rows.sourceNote: Principal beat/attack/finish-off senses plus public task-completion use. Task completion may suggest roughness, not inevitably carelessness. 破る's defeat and片付ける's completion/elimination senses were inspected beyond their short older titles.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1191990/やぬし/家主; landlord and homeowner/household-head uses.
rows.sourceNote: Nativeや+ぬし. 大家おおや is distinct from great-expertたいか/たいけ identities;主人 also has proprietor/household-head/landlord uses. A household or resident is not automatically the head or owner.
rows.identityNote: Landlord sense1 restricted toやぬし/いえぬし; obsoleteいえあるじ is not generalized.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1983750/やぶく/破く; transitive godan tear/rip.
rows.sourceNote: The pinned raw source gloss is empty and remains empty. Inspected complete family1983750 and public lexical body supply the tear/rip meaning without rewriting the source. Related破る's defeat/promise-breaking uses are not transferred automatically.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1471210/やぶれる/破れる; intransitive tearing/wearing and negotiation breakdown.
rows.sourceNote: Physical break and figurative failure comparisons require direct title/sense checks, not indiscriminate graph closure or a transitivity-only exemption.
rows.identityNote: Separate1472510敗れる defeat is contrast-only, not merged. Potential破れる of破る shares written form but is not this lexical intransitive identity.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1612100/やむをえない; kana ID for recognized complete expression.
rows.sourceNote: Recognizedやむを得ない/止むを得ない do not require kanji metadata on the kana-only card. Direct noun modification, noな. Cannot-be-helped overlap withしょうがない does not license its～てしょうがない intensity construction.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1605630/やわらかい/軟らかい; reuse existing baseline article covering all four unrestricted senses.
rows.sourceNote: Add explicit sourcedjlpt2 only. Preserve old title/body/exclusions and軟 reciprocal link. 柔らかい remains explicitlyN4; the two spellings do not have a mechanical physical-versus-figurative sense split. Existing exclusions are preservation scope, not all newly researched guards.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1542170/ゆうえんち/遊園地; amusement park.
rows.sourceNote: Do not infer every public park or place for play is an amusement park. Existing公園's displayed title is specifically public park, not unqualified park.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1542690/ゆうかん/夕刊; evening newspaper edition.
rows.sourceNote: KANJIDIC2 gives native夕ゆう plus on刊カン. Native-first mixed reading is storedwago, following actual existing夕飯 prior art; not falsely described as two on readings. Complete夕飯 body read after the411/920/173 receipt and before drafting, solely as format/classification prior art, not an added semantic comparison family.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1540080/ゆうこう/友好; friendship/friendly relations.
rows.sourceNote: Groups/countries are typical, not exclusive. Relational friendship senses of友情/仲良し differ from person-denoting友人/友達. Homophone有効 is unrelated and is not the mapping.

rows.mappingNote: Exact1542380/ゆうそう/郵送; sending through the postal service.
rows.sourceNote: Dispatch does not guarantee arrival. 出す's ordinary letter-sending sense5 and届ける's forwarding/sending sense1 were inspected despite older short titles. Postal charges, institutions, items and delivery outcomes are not automatically synonyms.

quizGuardRationale: Provisional direct symmetric/nontransitive judgments, not topical cliques. Whole older bodies, titles and ordinary secondary senses matter; POS/transitivity alone is not an exemption.

Government place/person and duty/function comparisons are separate direct judgments; executive, work and activity labels are not automatic synonyms. 薬品 has medicines and chemical-agent senses; general category labels remain reviewable.
Translation uses of直す and送る/出す/届ける secondary senses are assessed despite narrower older titles. Postal institutions, charges and items are not equivalent to dispatch.
Burn injury differs from burning activity. Night operation crosses steam/electric transport categories; train labels need individual checks rather than inherited cliques.
Arrow symbol and figurative attention are distinct. Indiscriminate/excessiveやたら and ordinary intensity have direct overlap, not every comparative or frequency use.
